messages:
neal (Security): Auditor requested a concise artifact tying a recent RBAC tweak to a KMS access pattern and the subsequent vuln triage ticket. They want a CSV join and a short control mapping doc. Can we get this by tomorrow morning?
priya (Infra): yes. We'll pull k8s audit for RoleBinding.patch events, CloudTrail KMS:Decrypt logs, and the vuln tracker (JIRA) change history for the related CVE ticket. What timezone do they want? UTC ISO8601 OK?
auditor_kim: UTC ISO8601 is ideal. Include fields: role_binding_uid, actor_email, change_diff, kms_request_id, decrypt_status, jira_ticket, triage_owner. Hash bundle with sha256 and provide presigned link.
neal (Security): also redact any customer emails; keep internal service_account names and internal ids. Priya, can you include the exact queries and person who ran them?
priya (Infra): running queries now. Example commands: 
```bash
# k8s audit: RoleBinding patches
jq 'select(.verb=="patch" and .objectRef.resource=="rolebindings") | {ts:.requestReceivedTimestamp, user:.user.username, uid:.objectRef.uid, patch:.requestObject}' k8s_audit.logl > rbac_patches.ndjson
# KMS Decrypt
aws logs filter-log-events --log-group-name /aws/kms --filter-pattern "Decrypt" --start-time 1711550000000 --end-time 1711553600000 --query 'events[].{ts:timestamp, requestId:message.requestID, keyId:message.keyId, principal:message.principalId}' > kms_decrypts.json
```
eng-bot: export job queued: job=exp-20260412-a1 ; owner=priya ; est_size=18MB ; destination=s3://redwood-audit/exp-20260412-a1.tar.gz
priya (Infra): upload complete. manifest at s3://redwood-audit/exp-20260412-a1/manifest.json sha256=5a6d7e8f9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f00123456789abcdef0123456789abcdeff
auditor_kim: thanks. please include the JIRA export and the ticket history. we need to know who triaged and when. Also include a short narrative mapping fields to SOC2 CC6/7 and ISO A.9/A.12.
neal (Security): I will produce the narrative and sign it. Also will confirm PII removal and chain-of-custody. Priya, please pseudonymize customer emails using the standard tool.
priya (Infra): scrub completed with infra/tools/redact.py --fields customer_email --mode pseudonymize. scrubbed bundle uploaded to s3://redwood-audit/exp-20260412-a1/scrubbed/ ; presigned link expires in 10 days: https://s3-presigned.example/exp-20260412-a1.tar.gz?sig=ZZZ
auditor_kim: got it. I'll review and come back with any narrow sample trace requests. Good job on quick turnaround.
neal (Security): filing evidence into the compliance tracker; retention note 90 days pending legal signoff. tagging @legal.
